signals.text: Core: ~~$20~~ $25 per month, billed monthly.
From today Core is a fiver more each month. Twenty-five, all in. Thread on where the money goes 🧵
Replit has nudged its Core subscription up by a quarter, to $25, the first move since the plan launched.
A fourth card sits between Pro and Business: Teams, $30 per seat monthly, one shared credit pool. It was not on the page in last week's capture.
say hello to Teams 👋 one bill, one credit pool, everybody in the same projects. thirty bucks a head.
anyone else seeing a Teams option on lovable's site? 30/seat, feels steep next to Pro
If you build on Bolt without paying, your monthly token allowance just more than tripled. No catch, nothing to switch on.
zero-dollar accounts: 1,000,000 tokens a month starting now. that's 3.3x what you had yesterday.
Bolt hands no-card accounts a million tokens a month, roughly three times the old allowance.
Billing toggle, yearly side: 'save 15%'. The same toggle read 'save 20%' in last week's capture.
Billing: paying for a year up front knocks 15% off rather than 20%. Monthly is untouched.
Cursor shaved five points off its pay-yearly discount this week; month-to-month subscribers aren't affected.
From December 1, Business folds into Enterprise. Business workspaces keep today's terms until renewal, then move across.
Homepage hero: 'Private projects are on the house.' Last week's homepage listed private projects as a Pro thing.
Pro folks: the 100-messages-a-day ceiling is gone. Go wild.
We've closed a $200M round to keep making software something anyone can build.
Your idea, live by lunch. No engineers required.
Starter won't be around for new accounts after November 15. Newcomers get a 14-day run of Core instead; existing Starter accounts stay put.
Agent can now stand up a Postgres database for you. Rolling out to every account today, including people who've never paid us a cent.
10M people have shipped something on Replit. Thank you 💛
How three seed-stage startups ship on Replit Teams ($40/user/mo, with SSO and shared deployments).
Replit Teams: double the monthly credits per seat. Still $40.
Teams card: $30 a seat. The same card said forty on last Tuesday's capture.
Pro: tokens you don't burn this month now carry into the next one, up to a month's worth.
Bolt Pro from $25/mo. Cancel anytime.
half off Pro for your first 3 months if you join before Sunday ⚡
Premium   20 USD/mo → 16 USD/mo
Free: $5 of monthly credits included. Prior capture showed $10.
Team is 10% lighter on the wallet from today: $27 a seat, or €25 p/m if you're billed in euros.
v0 is said to be testing a cheaper $10 tier for students, according to two people familiar with the plans.
heads up: Pro +$5 for anyone who subscribes from Nov 1. already on Pro? your rate holds through March.
The entry column is headed 'Free' now; last week's capture called it 'Hobby'.
Ultra: $200/mo. Unchanged from last week's capture.
Tab completions are ~30% faster on every tier. No price change, nothing to turn on.
Ultra down to $100/mo starting next week 👀
Bugbot is here: an automatic review on every PR you open. It comes with Pro and Ultra.
Every team at this weekend's hackathon walks away with $50 in credits. 400 teams, one weekend.
